title: Unified performance benchmark ledger
summary: Add a repeatable read-only performance benchmark, explicit JSONL ledger records, baseline summaries, and a runbook for comparing safe variants.
reason: Performance changes lacked one durable baseline format covering backend import, WebView asset load, pipeline module load, and optional engineering audit suites.
behavior_before: Performance investigations used one-off commands and did not persist comparable schema-versioned measurements.
behavior_after: The bundled runtime can repeat bounded benchmarks, fail on correctness regressions, emit full JSON, and append comparable JSONL measurements only when an explicit ledger path is supplied.
manual_validation: performance_benchmark --repeat 5 --variant baseline (pass; backend import median 728.125 ms, 186 external scripts, 70 PowerShell modules)
rollback_plan: Remove the benchmark/ledger modules, their focused tests and runbook, and the DOCS_INDEX entry. LocalBase benchmark artifacts are optional ignored runtime evidence.
notes:
Add shared performance record and JSONL ledger helpers.
Add repeatable read-only startup, static-shell, module-graph, and optional audit-suite benchmarks.
Cover performance summaries, ledger writes, static inventory, and record projection.
Document benchmark baselines, ledger behavior, and correctness boundaries.
Index the performance benchmark runbook.
Refresh generated summary for the performance change.
